Class AbstractBondDescriptor

java.lang.Object
org.openscience.cdk.qsar.AbstractBondDescriptor
All Implemented Interfaces:
IBondDescriptor, IDescriptor
Direct Known Subclasses:
AtomicNumberDifferenceDescriptor, BondPartialPiChargeDescriptor, BondPartialSigmaChargeDescriptor, BondPartialTChargeDescriptor, BondSigmaElectronegativityDescriptor, IPBondLearningDescriptor
public abstract class AbstractBondDescriptor extends Object implements IBondDescriptor
Abstract bond descriptor class with helper functions for descriptors that require the whole molecule to calculate the descriptor values, which in turn need to be cached for all bonds, so that they can be retrieved one by one.
